props.gloss_en: Rav Giddel used to go and sit at the gates of the immersion sites; he told them: immerse this way, immerse that way
in my eyes they are like white geese
R' Yochanan used to go and sit at the gates of the immersion sites
when the daughters of Israel come up from immersion they will look at me, and they will have children as handsome as I
I come from the seed of Joseph
the evil eye has no dominion over the seed of Joseph
the source: 'Joseph is a fruitful son, a fruitful son alei ayin' (Gen 49:22)
R' Abbahu: do not read alei ayin but olei ayin
from here: 'and may they teem like fish in the midst of the land' (Gen 48:16) -- as fish in the sea are covered by water and the evil eye has no dominion over them, so the seed of Joseph
an eye that did not wish to feed on what was not its own -- the evil eye has no dominion over it
